subject.title: feat: add account feed model API

question: Should this account/publisher feed API ship only after preserving existing personal-publisher compatibility and aligning with the related discovery/feed drafts, or is an ownerPublisherId-only first slice acceptable?
rationale: The PR adds a new public API/schema contract and overlaps an active discovery/feed stack, so automation cannot choose the long-term compatibility boundary for maintainers.

options.title: Fix compatibility before API review
options.body: Require the PR to reuse existing personal-publisher fallback paths, add regression coverage, and provide live route proof before the public contract is accepted.

options.title: Accept narrower first slice
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally ship ownerPublisherId-only feeds, but should state that legacy personal content can be absent from the first public API slice.

options.title: Pause for feed-stack alignment
options.body: Hold this draft until the account feed, publisher state, follow graph, registry bridge, and public publisher feed route drafts are ordered or split.

recommendation.title: Fix compatibility before API review
recommendation.body: Require the PR to reuse existing personal-publisher fallback paths, add regression coverage, and provide live route proof before the public contract is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is the strongest current-history owner for the publisher compatibility helpers and recent feed/dashboard baseline this PR extends.
